findings.title: Regression gate failed outside the permitted P04 handoff boundary
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires every prompt TEST to have a supported PASS/FAIL conclusion; criterion 4 requires stop conditions and successor-prompt boundaries to be honored.
findings.trigger: The t1 suite contains six newly failing cases outside the exact P04 root/resource handoff: four obsolete predecessor tests, one P00-owned live import break, and one frozen Plan 26 harness failure.
findings.consequence: P03 cannot pass its regression test or completion gate. The prompt explicitly requires all non-root/resource tests to pass and says to revert and stop when failures exceed the exact P04 handoff boundary.
findings.evidence: Report Test 7 records 35 new failures, including 5 checkpoint/P00 failures and 1 frozen-harness failure. The prompt’s Test 7 expected result requires every failing case to be predeclared and owned by an exact P04 test/path; its loop says, “Revert and stop if failures exceed the exact P04 handoff boundary.” The exception file also calls tools/refactor_repo/baseline.py:137 “a real, live functional break caused by P03” with no assigned fix owner.

findings.title: Independent QA test is incomplete
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 states that a skipped, unavailable, or inconclusive check is not PASS; criterion 7 forbids completion when the independent gate has not produced verified QA_PASSED.
findings.trigger: The independent QA test remains pending and has no witnessed verification result.
findings.consequence: Not all prompt tests pass, so the checkpoint cannot satisfy its completion gate.
findings.evidence: Section 7 says: “Pending — submitted to qa-gate-codex-run after this report.” The execution journal ends with ACT-011 still started and result=pending. The prompt requires witnessed `QA_PASSED` identifying the passing artifact.

findings.title: Required checkpoint identity fields are missing
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 1 requires the executing prompt, specification version, baseline commit, starting dirty state, and exact artifact version being judged.
findings.trigger: The report is used as the gated checkpoint record.
findings.consequence: A reviewer cannot establish from the artifact which specification and artifact version were judged or reconstruct the pre-execution dirty state.
findings.evidence: Section 1 names the prompt and baseline commit, but gives no specification version, no explicit starting dirty-state inventory, and no artifact version/digest. The filename contains `v1`, but the report does not identify that version as the exact judged artifact.

findings.title: Prompt tests lack exact reproducible procedures and statuses
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires every prompt TEST’s exact command or inspection procedure, exit status, material output, and supported PASS/FAIL conclusion.
findings.trigger: A reviewer attempts to reproduce Tests 1–8 from the report and referenced journal.
findings.consequence: Ownership, source-map reconciliation, relocation, origin checks, CLI behavior, regression classification, and rollback verification cannot be independently reproduced from the checkpoint record.
findings.evidence: The test sections mostly provide narrative summaries rather than exact commands and explicit exit statuses/conclusions. For example, Tests 1–3 supply no commands or exit status; Test 5 omits build/install/import commands and their individual statuses; Test 6 omits exact CLI invocations and preflight evidence. The execution log likewise describes actions but does not preserve the exact shell commands for these checks.

findings.title: The checkpoint lacks an exact path ledger and reviewable deliverable diff/digests
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 2 requires every changed, created, moved, and deleted path plus byte-for-byte preservation of pre-existing user changes; criterion 6 requires post-change git status and a reviewable diff or immutable digest for every deliverable.
findings.trigger: The checkpoint delta is reviewed for mutation-boundary compliance and content integrity.
findings.consequence: Reviewers cannot verify complete path ownership, distinguish checkpoint changes from pre-existing user changes, or authenticate every delivered file.
findings.evidence: Section 2 lists broad patterns and counts such as `runtime/**` and `src/curriculum_factory/**`, not every path. It states a summarized `git status --porcelain` result but includes neither its literal output nor a complete diff/path ledger. No reviewable full diff or per-deliverable immutable digest set is supplied.

reasoning: The strongest substantive defect is not stylistic evidence presentation: the reported regression set directly exceeds the prompt’s exact P04-only failure boundary, including a P03-caused live functional break. Independently, the mandatory QA result is pending. The report also omits several expressly required identity and reproducibility records. These are direct criterion failures at the stated blocker threshold.
